$description: THE `when` PREDICATE'S FIELD LIST — the legal LEFT-HAND names of the clauses in a meta's `when` gate. ONE home (ADR-0017 write-once). s251-D5 ruled the `when` value a PREDICATE over shape, prominence and span rather than prose, and said in as many words that the field list was "a further ruling, not made here"; s254-D2 item 2 is that further ruling: the list is closed, the resolver parses the predicate half and refuses an unknown name, and the per-field counts a review page quotes become SCRIPT OUTPUT rather than a human reading (this closes V-B's M2, where page B said 12 fields and the script found 11).
$grammar: A `when` value is GATE — PROSE, split on the FIRST em-dash (U+2014). Only the GATE half is parsed. The gate is clauses joined by `AND` / `OR`; a clause that opens with `<field> <operator>` is a FIELD CLAIM and its field name must be a key of `fields` below. A clause with NO operator is PROSE inside the gate (e.g. "parts sum to a whole", "both axes carry quantitative measures") — it carries no field name, is not parsed, and is not judged: that is the V-B operator-token method (notes/_subreports/2026-09-07-253-V-B.md, M2), kept verbatim so the count is reproducible. The prose half after the em-dash is the R2 beats/yields sentence (s253-D1) and is never parsed.

$provenance.ruled: s254-D2 item 2 (Dave, #254, 2026-09-07) — "`when` gains a closed list of legal left-hand field names, parsed by the resolver, so the page counts become script output (closes V-B's M2)"
$provenance.further-ruling-to: s251-D5 (Dave, #251, DESK RSQ 3: "q3. Predicate") — which deferred exactly this list
$provenance.method: notes/_subreports/2026-09-07-253-V-B.md M2 — the operator-token sweep over the gate half; every name below was READ OFF the 24 metas authored at #253 (plus `verdict`, authored onto runway-bar at #254), not invented
$provenance.resolver: knowledge/_validate_roles_resolve.py check 10 `when-fields-known` — an unknown field name refuses, loud and named; the per-field counts are PRINTED so a page can quote them

$extension: EXPECTED, by ruling only. A new predicate that needs a field not listed here PROPOSES it on a review page; Dave rules it in. A lane does not add one to make its own `when` parse.

answers.definition: the reader's question this provider is being asked for — an address into chart-intents.json

shape.definition: the data shape being offered — an address into shapes.json

span.cols.definition: the width band available, on the 12-column canon (s251-D10)

series.definition: how many series the data carries (`none` = zero)

categories.definition: how many categories the categorical dimension carries

variables.definition: how many variables are being described

bins.definition: the binning of a continuous variable (`contiguous` = no inter-bar gap)

parts.definition: how many parts a composition splits into

rows.definition: how many rows the reading carries

total.definition: whether a total figure is printed

units.definition: whether the measures share a unit (`different` / `same`)

delta.definition: whether a movement figure exists (`none` = it does not)

verdict.definition: whether a stated verdict-and-date is part of the reading (`none` = it is not)

depth.definition: how deep in the hierarchy the page sits

nav.levels.definition: how many levels of navigation exist

level.definition: the document level a title band sits at (`page` / `screen` / `section`)

lockup.definition: whether a lock-up (actions / tabs riding the band) is wanted

emphasis.definition: the action's emphasis tier (primary / secondary / tertiary / quaternary)

label.definition: what the trigger is labelled with (`text` / `glyph`)

content.definition: what an arrangement is being asked to hold

surface.definition: whether the arrangement paints a surface (`none` = it must not)
